body:
🏹 Advanced Manhunt | Tactical & Asymmetrical PvP
Tired of the classic Manhunt experience? Advanced Manhunt takes the escape and chase game you know to a whole new tactical level with special abilities, dynamic roles, and asymmetrical powers!

Whether you're a Hunter breathing down your opponents' necks, or a Runner using your adrenaline to survive. This mod is designed to bring a true "Mini-game" quality to the games you play with your friends.

✨ Key Features
Asymmetrical Roles: Players can be assigned as "Hunters" or "Runners". The moment roles are assigned, players' names, the TAB list, and nametags (Red for Hunters, Green for Runners) are automatically colored.

Flawless Tracking: Hunters can use the legendary compass that shows the exact location of the runners. Even if the target player dies, respawns, or moves to another dimension, the compass updates constantly.

Skill Menu System: Each role has its own unique item and ability. You can easily grab your abilities through a virtual chest GUI.

Balanced Gameplay: To prevent ability spamming, there are 60-second cooldowns for all skills.

🎒 Role Abilities
🔴 Hunters

Hunter's Radar: When used, it detects the location of all Runners on the map. It grants the "Glowing" effect to Runners for 10 seconds, making them visible even through walls. (60-Second Cooldown)

Tracking Compass: A magical compass that shows the real-time coordinates of your targeted Runner.

🟢 Runners

Adrenaline Rush: Use it when you are cornered or need a quick getaway! Accompanied by intense heartbeat sounds, it grants you Speed II and Jump Boost II for 10 seconds. (60-Second Cooldown)

📜 Commands
All the commands you need to manage and play the mod:

Admin (OP) Commands:

/manhunt role set <player_name> hunter - Makes a player a Hunter.

/manhunt role set <player_name> runner - Makes a player a Runner.

/manhunt role remove <player_name> - Removes the player's role and turns them back into a normal player.

Player Commands:

/hunt <runner_player_name> - (Hunters only) Gives you the compass tracking the specified Runner.

/skills (or /manhuntskills) - Opens the virtual skill menu where you can grab the ability items for your current role.

⚙️ Setup & Requirements
Minecraft Version: 1.21.1

Mod Loader: Fabric Loader (Recommended: 0.16.5+)

Requirement: The Fabric API mod is strictly required.

It works perfectly when installed on both the server and the client for the best visual experience.

More abilities and tactical traps will be added in future updates. Feel free to report bugs or suggest new ability ideas in the comments. Happy hunting!
